title: Tech Recruiter
description:
**About Hevo:**

At **Hevo Data**, we’re building the future of data infrastructure for AI. Over 2,000 companies across 40+ countries trust Hevo to power their analytics. As a deep tech company, our engineering team solves some of the hardest problems in data integration, scale, and reliability. We’re looking for a **Technical** **Recruiter**who goes beyond keyword matching. We want someone who can **understand the technology, assess candidates based on their past technical projects/work, and match them to the role we’re hiring for**.

If you can speak the language of engineers and help us identify the very best, let’s talk.

### **Job Responsibilities:**

* Partner with engineering leaders to understand what a great candidate for that role looks like in each technical role.
* Evaluate candidate fitment by reviewing their past work, technical contributions, and problem-solving approaches.
* Conduct structured technical conversations to pre-assess candidates before formal interviews.
* Build and nurture long-term pipelines of deep-tech engineers in Backend, Frontend, DevOps, and Data Infra.
* Apply a systematic approach to **target, network and engage with passive talent pools**.
* Deliver an engaging candidate experience and be the brand ambassador for Hevo in this community of users.

### **Desired Candidate Profile:**

* 3-5 years of technical recruiting experience with a focus on senior engineering roles.
* Ability to understand engineering depth—you don’t need to code, but you should be able to evaluate whether a backend engineer has built for scale, or if a DevOps engineer has automated infra at complexity.
* Track record of closing engineering hires at product or deep-tech companies.
* Ability to assess candidates beyond resumes—by understanding their technical impact and role fit.
* Excellent storytelling skills to articulate Hevo’s vision to top engineers.
* Passion for technology and curiosity to dive into systems design, distributed infra, and cutting-edge data problems.

**Why Join Us:**
----------------

* **Build the Force that Builds the Future of Data:** At Hevo, we’re solving one of the hardest problems in data: building a reliable, scalable backbone for modern analytics. Your role is to assemble the team that makes this possible.
* **Solve Hard Talent Problems:** We’re hiring SDEs in domains where top talent is scarce. You’ll lead the challenge of finding and convincing these engineers to join a fast-rising deep-tech product company.
* **Partner with Engineering Leadership:** You’ll work shoulder-to-shoulder with our founders and senior engineering leaders, not only to hire but to influence role design, bar-setting, and long-term team structure.
* **Build a Talent Brand in the Data Space:** Hevo is competing with companies globally. You’ll play a key role in building Hevo’s reputation among senior engineers through outreach, positioning, and community presence.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

description:

This is a contractual role.

As a Full Lifecycle Recruiter I, you will manage the end\-to\-end recruiting process — from sourcing and engaging candidates to preparing them for interviews and closing offers. You will partner with hiring teams to understand their needs, build strong candidate pipelines, and deliver a positive experience for every person who interacts with Amazon during the hiring process.  

  

This is a role for someone who is curious, resourceful, and motivated by the challenge of finding the right person for the right opportunity. You will use data\-driven sourcing strategies, creative outreach methods, and your growing knowledge of Amazon's culture to attract qualified candidates efficiently. If you thrive in a fast\-paced environment and enjoy building relationships with both candidates and internal partners, we want to hear from you.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Source and engage candidates using internal and external tools, Boolean search logic, and multiple sourcing channels to build high\-quality, unbiased candidate pipelines aligned with hiring team goals and service\-level expectations.

* Coach candidates on behavioral interviewing techniques and the overall interview process to ensure they are well\-prepared, creating a consistently positive candidate experience throughout the hiring journey.
* Partner with hiring managers and recruiting team members to calibrate candidate profiles, share pipeline insights, and surface blockers or process improvement opportunities that strengthen hiring effectiveness.
* Leverage recruiting data and reporting mechanisms to track candidate funnel quality, measure sourcing project outcomes, and maintain data integrity across all recruiting systems and documentation.

  

A day in the life  

You will start your morning reviewing your candidate pipeline, following up with prospects, and scheduling pre\-screen calls. Throughout the day, you will connect with candidates to learn about their backgrounds, walk them through what to expect from Amazon's interview process, and help them put their best foot forward. You will also join intake meetings with hiring managers, collaborate with your recruiting team on sourcing strategies, and update candidate records to keep your data clean and actionable.  

  

About the team  

Our recruiting team is dedicated to delivering an outstanding hiring experience for candidates and internal partners alike. We work collaboratively to meet hiring goals while continuously improving our processes and tools. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. title: Technical Consulting Engineer
description:
Who We Are
  
**The name ThousandEyes was born from two big ideas:** the power to see things not ordinarily possible and the ability to collect insights from a multitude of vantage points. As the world continues its digital transformation and relies more on cloud services and the Internet, the"network" which is now both public and private, has become a black box our customers cannot see or understand.
  
  

Our Internet and cloud intelligence platform delivers the only collectively powered real\-time view of the Internet and private networks, cloud, and SaaS platforms, helping enterprises and service providers identify problems before they impact revenue, damage brand reputation, or halt employee productivity.
  
  

In August 2020, Cisco Systems completed the acquisition of ThousandEyes, which now forms the ThousandEyes Business Unit within the Cisco Networking Business Group and is the Network Assurance solution for Cisco across the Cisco Networking Cloud and Cisco Security Cloud. ThousandEyes is also a foundational component of Cisco’s growing Full\-Stack Observability "FS") business.
  
  

About The Role
  
We're all familiar with the technology, but have you ever wondered how the Internet actually works? At ThousandEyes, we spend every day working to help customers understand the gotchas of Internet\-based service delivery: how to identify problems, how to resolve, and how to avoid them in the future. Our Customer Engineering Support team who is now part of Cisco TAC is tasked with empowering our customers with ThousandEyes to ease their performance monitoring pains.
  
  

If you enjoy variety in job responsibilities, this is the job for you. A day may involve helping a customer identify network loss in an undersea cable, diagnose the cause of a route leak impacting significant portions of internet traffic, scripting an approach to monitoring a website's login flow, spinning up a lab environment to reproduce a strange set of behaviors seen in a customer's environment, saving a company hours of bridge time during a significant outage impacting their infrastructure by finding the smoking\-gun in a network outage, or simply helping someone understand the way that our applications work. * Expert\-level certifications (e.g. CCIE) or equivalent advance technical credentials preferred
* Experience with Cloud/SaaS software products is highly desirable

* Experienced knowledge of virtualization technology \- containers, virtualBox, VMware, HyperV, Xen

Why Cisco?
  
  

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
